name: The Harbor Crew Cross-Chain Report
summary: A paid batch report for 1–5 public EVM addresses across Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum One and Polygon. A keyless JSON API returns EIP-7702 indicators, code size, SHA-256 and explorer links. One batch costs 0.02 native USDC on Base; a compatible wallet approved by its owner pays and signs a message binding the payment to the address batch. Reports do not establish ownership, malicious intent or recovery authority.

payments.notes: 0.02 native USDC per batch is paid directly to the operator on Base. The payer's authorized wallet approves payment and signs a free personal_sign message. Wait 12 confirmations. The registry has no direct-transfer protocol or humanBilling value.

agentAccess.notes: No account or API key. Use the browser form or keyless JSON API. API use requires an explicitly authorized compatible Base wallet to send 0.02 USDC plus gas and sign a personal_sign message binding the address batch to the payment; the service waits for 12 confirmations.

disclosure.statement: This listing and service were prepared with autonomous-agent assistance. The human operator controls the deployment and receiving wallet. Reports read public blockchain data and do not prove ownership, malicious intent or authority to recover assets.
